title: Catching Up with an Old Friend

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where people get their hair cut
vocabulary.example: She works at a hair salon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where cars are repaired
vocabulary.note_ar: وأيضًا: مكان لركن السيارة في البيت
vocabulary.note_en: Also: a building where you park your car.
vocabulary.example: My car is at the garage.
He cuts hair at the salon.
I remember when she was a baby.
My son just started playing soccer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: make the sound of being happy
vocabulary.example: She makes me laugh every day.

fine_lines.title: like + -ing vs like + noun
fine_lines.explanation_ar: بعد like يمكن أن نستخدم اسمًا (I like my job) أو فعلًا بـ ing (I like fixing cars).
fine_lines.explanation_en: After "like" use a noun or verb-ing.

examples.sentence: Yes, but I like my job.

fine_lines.title: daughter vs son
fine_lines.explanation_en: Daughter = girl child. Son = boy child.

examples.sentence: My son just started playing soccer.

expressions.meaning_en: A friendly greeting after a long time.
expressions.example: Hi, Jimmy! Long time no see.
You fixed three cars today? That's a lot of work!

expressions.phrase: Do you still like cutting hair?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل ما زلت تحب قصّ الشعر؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ask if something is still true.
expressions.example: Do you still like your job?
How is your son? He's good.

expressions.phrase: She makes me laugh every day.
expressions.example: My little brother makes me laugh every day.

expressions.phrase: I remember when she was a baby.
expressions.example: I remember when you were a child.
He's ten now? Kids change so quickly.

expressions.phrase: We should catch up more often.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن نلتقي ونتبادل الأخبار أكثر.
expressions.meaning_en: Say you want to meet more.
expressions.example: It was nice to talk. We should catch up more often.

expressions.phrase: Let's not wait so long next time.
expressions.meaning_ar: دعنا لا ننتظر طويلًا في المرة القادمة.
expressions.meaning_en: Say you want to meet again soon.
expressions.example: Let's not wait so long next time. Sounds good.

grammar.title: Present simple: likes and jobs
grammar.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن العمل والأشياء التي نحبها بالمضارع البسيط: I like my job. I work a lot at the garage. ومع he/she نضيف s: She likes to help.
grammar.explanation_en: Present simple for jobs and likes. Add -s with he/she.
examples: I work a lot at the garage.

grammar.title: Past simple: Today I fixed... / It was...
grammar.explanation_ar: للحدث الذي انتهى: Today I fixed a big car. It was not easy. I remember when she was a baby.
examples: Today I fixed a big car.
My son just started playing soccer.

grammar.title: make + someone + verb / adjective
grammar.explanation_ar: make + شخص + فعل: She makes me laugh. أو make + شخص + صفة: I make them happy.
examples: She makes me laugh every day.
I like making them happy with their hair.

questions.question: I haven't seen you for a long time! — Long time no ___.
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة الثابتة: Long time no see.
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is "Long time no see".

questions.question: Today I ___ a big car.
questions.explanation_ar: Today مع حدث انتهى: الماضي fixed.

questions.question: I like ___ cars.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد like يمكن الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: A place where cars are repaired is a ___.
A female child is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A daughter is a girl child.

questions.question: Take care, Jimmy. — ___
questions.explanation_ar: الرد على Take care: You too.
